about: OpenNavo Taiwan wording applied after the OpenCC s2twp conversion, to prose only: protected literals, code, URLs and placeholders keep their text. Users follow these names into System Settings, so they match macOS Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). Rules apply in order; a rule whose replacement extends its source skips text that already has the extension. Repository interface text, release notes and server-side content all use these rules; changing them needs a new converter Version. This is OpenNavo data, not part of the pinned upstream files in upstream.json.
